en.title: [Deadline Approaching / Startup Support Foundation] Looking for the Winner of 1 Billion KRW in Total Prizes (~Oct 27 (Tue) 14:00)
summary: Recruiting participants for the 2027 Government Support Project Preparation Class [RE:START X Startup Connect (창업으로 잇-지)], a preliminary startup incubation program.

Eligible applicants must have no prior business registration history as of the announcement date and must be able to attend all 8 sessions and Demo Day; open to re-challenge prospective entrepreneurs (such as 2026 Everyone's Startup participants) or prospective entrepreneurs residing or attending school (재학) in Incheon/Gyeonggi.
Schedule and venue: November 4, 2026 (Wed) – December 30, 2026 (Wed), every Wednesday 14:00–17:00 (tentative), Kim Hyun-tae Inha Dream Center B1 Startup Dream Hall.
How to apply: Submit online via Google Forms (https://forms.gle/sdah2zmUJAhqLepG6).
en.easyExplanation: This is an 8-session incubation program by the Startup Support Foundation (창업지원단) helping prospective entrepreneurs prepare for government funding, covering everything from proposal writing to prototype (MVP) development. You can apply if you have no business registration history as of the announcement date, reside or attend school (재학) in Incheon/Gyeonggi (including re-challenge founders from the 2026 Everyone's Startup program), and can commit to all sessions. Applications must be submitted through Google Forms by October 27 (Tue) at 14:00.
en.target: Prospective entrepreneurs attempting a startup re-challenge such as participants of 2026 Everyone's Startup (2026년 모두의창업), or prospective entrepreneurs residing or currently attending school (재학) in the Incheon or Gyeonggi area (must have no history of business registration as of the announcement date and must be able to attend all 8 education sessions and Demo Day).
en.eventInfo: The first session of the 2027 Government Support Project Preparation Class at Kim Hyun-tae Inha Dream Center B1 Startup Dream Hall.

originalContent:
[인하대학교 창업지원단]
📢 2027년 정부지원사업 준비반 모집
[RE:START X 창업으로 잇-지]는 지원사업 이해부터 사업 제안서 작성, 시제품(MVP) 제작까지
지원사업 도전에 필요한 준비를 한 번에 돕는 예비창업자 인큐베이팅 프로그램입니다.
📅 모집기간
2026. 10. 16.(금) ~ 10. 27.(화) 14시까지
👤 모집대상
- 2026년 모두의창업 참여자 등 창업 재도전 예비창업자
- 인천·경기지역 거주 또는 재학 중인 예비창업자
✅ 참여자격
- 공고일 기준 사업자 등록 이력이 없는 예비창업자
- 8회차 교육 및 데모데이 전 과정 참여가 가능한 분
👥 모집인원: 30명 내외
🗓 운영일정
2026. 11. 4.(수) ~ 12. 30.(수) 매주 수요일 14:00~17:00(예정)
📍 장소
인하대학교 김현태인하드림센터 지하 1층 창업드림홀
(인천광역시 미추홀구 인하로 100)
🎁 참여혜택
- 최우수 성과달성자 상품 지급(최신 전자기기 등)
- 모두의창업 지원시 창업지원단장명의 추천서 제공
- 인하대학교 창업지원단장 명의 수료증 발급
👉 신청하기
https://forms.gle/sdah2zmUJAhqLepG6

032-860-9152
